Hi Alyssa / Carlos —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward your Q1 target: 

What we covered
- Live demo (generative search + controlled outputs) with 3 example flows: customer support routing, policy-compliant summaries, and embeddings for semantic search.
- Cost and latency profile for a 5k queries/day pilot (estimated 0.9ms median token latency on dedicated tier).
- Security controls: SSO, customer-managed KMS, audit logs demo (Laura covered the high level).

Decision owner mapping (requested) — can you confirm the owners below?
- Economic buyer: Alyssa Moore (you mentioned CFO level) — confirm actual approver (name/title)
- Technical evaluator: Carlos Jimenez (platform/infra lead)
- Security reviewer: ? (security@finco.com or specific contact)
- Procurement lead: ? (procurement@finco.com or Thomas/Tom H.)

Key decision criteria we heard
1) Data residency and audit logs (must have SOC2 evidence + per-call audit)
2) Cost predictability (monthly committed vs variable)
3) Latency SLOs for peak traffic (99th percentile target)
4) Integration effort for SSO / SCIM

Proposed immediate next steps
- You confirm decision owners above (today) — owner names + emails
- Laura to share security appendix and SOC2 link (Ben and Karthik can support) — by EOD Wed 12/2
- Schedule a procurement/finance sync with Tom Hensley and Alyssa — propose Wed 12/8 11am ET
- Draft SLA & PO terms (initial ask: 30-day pilot with committed capacity + pilot SLA) — Ben to send draft by Thu 12/3

Attachments: demo-factsheet.pdf (product summary + pilot sizing)

Open questions for you
- Is the economic buyer the CFO (Ellen Park) or VP of Product?
- Are there any mandatory legal clauses or procurement templates we should pre-load into the contract?

If you prefer, we can convert the decision-owner list into a one-page RACI and circulate — let me know.

Thanks,
